topPros.title: dark meat stays flavorful and forgiving to cook
topPros.explanation: That makes chicken thigh easier to use well in real meals than drier leaner cuts.

topPros.title: usually a reasonably affordable whole-food protein
topPros.explanation: Chicken thigh is often cheaper than premium animal proteins while still providing a substantial protein serving.

topPros.title: easy to build complete meals around
topPros.explanation: It works as an actual centrepiece protein rather than a garnish ingredient.

topCons.title: fattier than lean poultry options like breast meat
topCons.explanation: That tradeoff is part of why thigh tastes better but is not the cleanest poultry profile.

topCons.title: the final health profile changes a lot with cooking method
topCons.explanation: Breading, deep frying, or skin-on preparation can shift the outcome substantially from this base record.

topCons.title: raw poultry needs careful handling
topCons.explanation: Food-safety friction is a practical downside versus foods that are safer or easier to store and prep.
